resources.string: NowFocus uses this to see which app comes to the foreground, so it can block the apps you chose - during focus sessions and any Commitment Shield - and, if you turn it on, to lock your screen at your Bedtime sleep time. If you turn on partial blocking, it also reads the YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok screens - only while a session or Commitment Shield with those options is running - to spot Shorts, Reels and recommendation lists. This feature is experimental. If you add a daily limit for a website, it also reads the address bar of your browser, only while that browser is in front, to count the time spent on the sites you limited; the pages you visit are not stored. Nothing else on screen is read, and nothing leaves your device.
